title: An Lushan rebellion
summary: A general’s revolt nearly destroys the Tang and kills a vast share of the registered population.
body: Census collapses are not simple death counts, but the social shock is not in doubt. Court power never fully recovered its early-Tang confidence. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.

sources.name: Pulleyblank, The Background of the Rebellion of An Lu-shan
